study type: Mixed-methods (qualitative phenomenological and quasi-experimental pre-test/post-test control group design)
exposure: Nurse-led structured breast hygiene education program
cohort: Sixty primigravida mothers were equally divided into an experimental and a control group.
finding: Nurse-led educational interventions significantly enhanced breast hygiene knowledge and practices in primigravida mothers in the experimental group post-intervention, unlike the control group.
